# Locations & Battles

## Avenue {#avenue}

The Avenue, named by the locals of [Newbridge](../codex/places.md#newbridge) and dubbed the "White Way of Delight" by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), is a four- to five-hundred-yard stretch of road completely arched over by wide-spreading apple trees planted by an eccentric old farmer.

## Avonlea {#avonlea}

Avonlea is a rural community where [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), home to [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Lovers' Lane are located.

**Associated with:** [Bentley](../character/bentley.md), [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Stacy](../character/stacy.md)

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys an active summer outdoors following a doctor's recommendation and returns to her studies in autumn with renewed vigor. Over the winter, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) prepares the Queen's class for the daunting [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notices Anne's rapid growth and growing maturity, feeling a quiet sense of loss as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prepares for her future.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk to school together via the [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path), discussing school gossip, classmates, and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's return. During class, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) tries to get Anne's attention by pulling her hair and calling her "Carrots." Furious, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) smashes her slate over Gilbert's head and is punished by Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), refusing to forgive [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) afterward.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

## Beechwood {#beechwood}

Beechwood is the residence of [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md), located in town, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stays while taking her [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams.

**Associated with:** [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md)

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) meets [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in Lover's Lane with news that her [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) has invited them both to [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) for the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). After getting Marilla's permission, the girls travel to town, stay at Aunt Josephine's grand house, and enjoy several days of exciting sights, including horse races, a balloon ascension, a concert, and late-night ice cream before returning home.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life

## Birch Path {#birch-path}

Named by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), the Birch Path is a narrow, scenic woodland trail fringed with white birches and wild flora that runs through Mr. Bell's woods to the main road, serving as part of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and Diana's picturesque route to school.

## Bolingbroke {#bolingbroke}

Bolingbroke is a town in [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) where [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) was born in a small yellow house, and where her parents, Walter and [Bertha Shirley](../character/bertha-shirley.md), worked as high school teachers before both dying of fever.

**Associated with:** [Shirley](../character/shirley.md)

## Boston {#boston}

Boston is a city where a cousin of [Josie](../character/josie-pye.md) Pye's mother resides and is married to a man who attended school with a distinguished, romantic-looking artist.

## Bright River {#bright-river}

Bright River is a location eight miles from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), featuring a train station house with a long platform and a small hotel with a yard.

> [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) travels to the Bright River station expecting to pick up an orphan boy, but finds a young orphan girl waiting for him instead. Rather than telling her immediately about the mistake, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) agrees to drive her back to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and lets her chatter happily as they begin their journey.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised

## Camelot {#camelot}

Camelot is a romantic, historical setting featured in Tennyson's poetry, which [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) envies for its old-fashioned romance and incorporates into a dramatic game with her friends.

## Canada {#canada}

Canada is a nation governed from Ottawa whose political affairs are a frequent topic of debate among electors like Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).

## Carmody {#carmody}

Carmody is a nearby location that hosts meetings for the [Aid Society](../codex/factions.md#aid-society).

## Charlottetown {#charlottetown}

Charlottetown is a location on Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island) where travelers can board a train and observe the area's distinctive red roads.

**Associated with:** [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md)

## Dryad’s Bubble {#dryad-s-bubble}

The Dryad's Bubble is a spring located in a hollow near a log bridge and a spruce path that leads to [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), named by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) after a spring in a story.

## Edward Island {#edward-island}

Edward Island, also referred to as Prince Edward Island, is a region where custom dictates that travelers nod to everyone they meet on the road.

## England {#england}

England is a distant location mentioned by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) as a place far enough from the [Island](../codex/places.md#island) that adopting a child from there might yield someone quite different from local residents.

## Entrance {#entrance}

The Entrance is an examination taken by advanced students to qualify for admission into Queen's.

## Europe {#europe}

Europe is a destination mentioned by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her fictional story as the place where the wealthy character [Bertram](../character/bertram.md) DeVere planned to take his bride for a wedding tour.

## Exhibition {#exhibition}

The Exhibition is an event held in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown) to which [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) invited [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to visit and stay with her at [Beechwood](../codex/places.md#beechwood).

**Participants:** [Harmon Andrews](../character/harmon-andrews.md), [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)

## Green Gables {#green-gables}

Green Gables is the secluded, meticulously kept [Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) family homestead in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), featuring a big, rambling house situated at the far edge of their cleared land at the end of a long, grassy lane.

**Associated with:** [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md)

> Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) observes [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) unexpectedly leaving home in his best clothes, which prompts her to visit Green Gables to investigate. [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) explains that [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) has gone to [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) to pick up an orphan boy they are adopting from [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia) to help on the farm. Mrs. Rachel voices strong warnings and skepticism about the decision before leaving to spread the news.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised

> [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) drives the young orphan girl toward Green Gables as she talks endlessly about her appearance, her deep appreciation for beautiful places like the 'Avenue' and 'Barry's Pond', and her joy at finally having a home. As they arrive at Green Gables, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) dreads the moment [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) will have to tell the child that her arrival is a mistake.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wakes up at Green Gables and admires the scenery, naming a cherry tree [Snow Queen](../codex/places.md#snow-queen) and a geranium Bonny. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) instructs her on chores and breakfast, noting Matthew's quiet insistence on keeping the girl. Afterward, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) prepares to drive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back to see Mrs. [Spencer](../character/spencer.md), while [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) silently watches them depart.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER IV. Morning at Green Gables

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrive at Mrs. Spencer's home to clarify the mix-up regarding the orphan child. When the harsh Mrs. [Blewett](../character/blewett.md) offers to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as a servant, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) hesitates and decides to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back home to consult [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). Later at Green Gables, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) that they should keep and raise [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) themselves.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) goes to put [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to bed and instructs her on neatness before discovering that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) does not know how to pray. At Marilla's request, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) improvises a unique, businesslike prayer before being tucked in for the night. Afterward, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns downstairs and tells [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) that they must see to Anne's upbringing and religious education.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers

## Haunted Wood {#haunted-wood}

The Haunted Wood is a gloomy spruce grove located over the brook that [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) imaginatively populated with romantic ghosts, including a wailing white lady, a murdered child's ghost near [Idlewild](../codex/places.md#idlewild), a headless man, and skeletons.

## Hopeton {#hopeton}

Hopeton is a place where Mrs. Alexander Spencer's cousin lives and the location of an orphan asylum.

## Idlewild {#idlewild}

Idlewild is the poetical name invented by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for the playhouse she and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) set up in a ring of white birch trees on Mr. William Bell's land.

## Island {#island}

The Island is a region located close to [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia), where local residents contrast its native-born populace with those from places such as [Hopeton](../codex/places.md#hopeton), [England](../codex/places.md#england), or the [States](../codex/places.md#states).

## Lover {#lover}

Lover's Lane is a romantic pathway opening below the [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) orchard, extending into the woods to the end of the [Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) farm, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) use as part of their scenic walk to school.

## Lynde’s Hollow {#lynde-s-hollow}

Lynde’s Hollow is a depression where the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) main road dips down, featuring a home, an orchard, a quiet brook fringed with alders and ladies’ eardrops, and a view of the steep red hill road leading out of the peninsula.

## Marysville {#marysville}

Marysville is a place where Mr. and Mrs. [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) moved after leaving [Bolingbroke](../codex/places.md#bolingbroke), and where [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) lived and briefly attended school until she was eight years old.

## Merry Christmas {#merry-christmas}

Taking place on a snowy morning, Merry Christmas was a festive occasion marked by [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) gifting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a fashionable brown dress with puffed sleeves made by Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) sending her kid slippers, and the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) scholars successfully staging an evening concert.

## New Brunswick {#new-brunswick}

New Brunswick is a region where [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) visited his cousins over the summer and the location of a tragic incident in which an adopted girl poisoned her family's well.

## Newbridge {#newbridge}

Newbridge is a bustling little village featuring a tree-canopied stretch of road called the "[Avenue](../codex/places.md#avenue)" that leads down a long slope into the town.

## Nova Scotia {#nova-scotia}

Nova Scotia is a Canadian region home to an orphan asylum, situated close to Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island).

## Orchard Slope {#orchard-slope}

Orchard Slope is the home of [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) and her family, featuring a house with a western gable located up through a brook and the firs from [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

**Associated with:** [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md)

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes talking with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and heads to Orchard Slope to apologize to [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) for the bed-jumping incident. Despite Diana's fears, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) bravely confesses to Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) and wins her over with her candor and vivid imagination. Miss [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) decides to stay in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), and she and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) become close friends.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession

## Queen’s Academy {#queen-s-academy}

Queen’s Academy is an educational institution located in town where students pursue classwork and teacher's licenses, as well as compete for honors such as medals and the Avery scholarship.

**Associated with:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Moody Spurgeon MacPherson](../character/moody-spurgeon-macpherson.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md)

## Redmond College {#redmond-college}

Redmond College is an institution of higher learning that [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) was eligible to attend using her scholarship before deciding to forego her studies there to remain at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

## Rome {#rome}

_Not yet known._

## Shining Waters {#shining-waters}

The Lake of Shining Waters is a long, winding body of water—locally known as Barry's pond—spanned by a bridge and surrounded by sand-hills, marshland, and groves of fir and maple.

## Snow Queen {#snow-queen}

The Snow Queen is the name given by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) to the exceptionally white, blooming cherry tree located outside her bedroom window.

## Spencervale {#spencervale}

Spencervale is a nearby locale whose resident physician attended to [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) during her bout with croup and later advised [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) regarding Anne's health.

**Associated with:** [Chester Ross](../character/chester-ross.md)

## States {#states}

The States is a foreign region where [French](../codex/factions.md#french) farm workers frequently relocate after learning local agricultural practices, located at a greater distance from Prince [Edward Island](../codex/places.md#edward-island) than [Nova Scotia](../codex/places.md#nova-scotia).

## Victoria Island {#victoria-island}

Victoria Island is a ravishing spot discovered by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) up the brook, featuring two maple trees and surrounded by the flowing brook, which they named in honor of finding it on the Queen's birthday.

## Violet Vale {#violet-vale}

Violet Vale is a green dimple in the shadow of Mr. Andrew Bell's woods, named by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), that sits along the scenic route she and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) take to school and is said to be filled with millions of violets in the spring.

## White Sands Hotel {#white-sands-hotel}

The White Sands Hotel is a large establishment run by Mr. Kirke along the shore, popular with [American](../codex/factions.md#american) tourists visiting for the summer season.

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dress at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for a benefit concert at the White Sands Hotel, while [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) looks on with quiet pride. [Billy Andrews](../character/billy-andrews.md) drives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane.md) to the hotel, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) initially experiences severe stage fright upon seeing the sophisticated crowd and accomplished performers. However, catching sight of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) sparks her determination, leading her to deliver a glowing recitation that wins enthusiastic applause and praise from the audience.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

## Willowmere {#willowmere}

Willowmere is a scenic location situated past Mr. Barry's back field along the romantic route that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk to school.
